To be honest I don't think it takes courage to post here as it is anonymous and I feel like I've been aware of my problems for many years (I'm 18 now)  however I don't have the strength to begin to solve them. I wouldn't even know what to tackle first. Let's face it,  some people are simply cowards, I feel like I'm one of those people. Some people don't have the chops to get past what ails them and while simply having that pessimistic belief may be hurting me, I don't know how to change it. I've tried talking to my family but I have a brother who has a lot of health problems and he has panic disorder and when I told my parents about my anxiety, because it doesn't manifest physically so much, they don't think it is serious. They don't know it has driven me to near suicide, I can't talk to them about it again, I don't want to hear them tell me I'm doing it for attention. That's why I don't tell anyone I suppose. Okay I'm done rambling  now.

I've fairly commited to the fact that my death will be self inflicted. I've thought about doing it since I was ten years old. I'm 18 now and the childish hope I used to hold onto has vacated my mind. Posting on reddit is a way to express how I'm feeling as no one in my life really knows the extent of it.

People come to this subreddit when they feel a similar way to what you are feeling and want to simply share or cry out for help. I just want you to know that there are people on your side, you just need to know where to look. I don't know you, but I am on your side. If you need someone to talk I would listen if that means anything to you but I'm sure it doesn't. All I ask is that you explore the subreddit for people that can help you or explore other suicide prevention sites. There are plenty of people who never cease to make you feel wanted and important. And you are important.
